name: runt9
description: Opt-in Claude Code plugins: the development process, code and test review, delegation and session tooling

plugins.name: lens-review
plugins.description: Runs a repository's own panel of reviewer agents over a diff, merges their findings into one graded report and delivers it where the repository's profile says

plugins.name: reference-kb
plugins.description: Reference knowledge bases in .claude/reference/: the note format, templates, a validator with a merge gate for CI, and a writer agent

plugins.name: develop
plugins.description: A ticket-to-reviewed-draft-pull-request process driven by a per-repository development profile, with an effort-estimate skill and a comment-sweep agent

plugins.name: teammate-delivery
plugins.description: Lets a teammate that is mid-turn read a message on its next model request, not after the turn is over

plugins.name: test-review
plugins.description: Judges whether existing tests earn their place, proves each verdict by breaking the code under test, and fixes the tests

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: How a lead session spawns, briefs, answers and shuts down Agent Teams teammates, with engineer, web-researcher, code-researcher, verifier and triager agent templates

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: A pane of decisions and tasks waiting on the owner, the agents' own tasks and what each agent is doing, kept on screen until answered
